newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AOT SAYS TO TAKE OVER BORGHOLS & IJDEMA.
newsitem.headline: AOT SAYS TO TAKE OVER BORGHOLS & IJDEMA.

text.p: Amsterdam options traders AOT said on Wednesday they had reached agreement on a takeover of specialist bond trader Borghols & IJdema.

"The takeover will be financed partly by the issue of 250,000 AOT shares whereby it is to be expected that the takeover will have a positive effect on profits per share in 1997," AOT said in a statement.
"For AOT, the takeover means a further expansion of its activities in the fixed-income sector. The specialist functions fit well with AOT money brokers and with inter-dealer broker BHI," AOT said.
Borghols & IJdema has four dealers, and the current management will remain associated with the company, AOT said.
